body: **Moving to a Smaller Home: What to Toss** **Meta Description:** Downsizing your home? Learn what items to keep and what to toss when moving to a smaller space. **Keywords:** downsizing, smaller home, decluttering, junk removal, 1-800-GOT-JUNK?, moving tips When it's time to downsize and move into a smaller home, the task can be overwhelming. The thought of sorting through years of accumulated belongings, deciding what to keep and what to let go of, can be daunting. But with a clear plan and the right guidance, you can simplify the process and make the transition smoother. **Purge Before You Move** Before we dive into what to toss, let's talk about the importance of purging your belongings before you start packing. This will save you time, energy, and reduce your overall moving costs. Consider the following: - **Start Early**: Begin the decluttering process as soon as possible to avoid last-minute stress. - **Sort Items into Categories**: Group items into three piles: keep, donate/sell, and discard. - **Be Honest with Yourself**: Ask yourself if you truly need or use each item. - **Don't Get Emotional**: Avoid holding onto items out of sentimental value. **What to Toss** Not everything will make the cut when moving to a smaller home. Here are some common items to consider letting go of: - **Duplicates**: If you have multiple items that serve the same purpose, consider keeping only your favorite or the one in the best condition. - **Broken or Damaged Items**: If an item is beyond repair, it's time to let it go. - **Outdated or Obsolete Items**: If you haven't used an item in years, it's probably safe to discard it. - **Large or Bulky Items**: Consider the space you'll have in your new home and let go of items that won't fit. **What to Keep** Not everything will go into the discard pile. Consider keeping items that: - **Have Sentimental Value**: If an item holds memories or emotional significance, consider keeping it. - **Are in Good Condition**: If an item is still in good condition and serves a purpose, keep it. - **Are Unreplaceable**: If an item is unique or cannot be easily replaced, consider keeping it. **Additional Tips for Downsizing** - **Enlist the Help of Friends and Family**: Ask for help when sorting through belongings. - **Consider Professional Help**: If you're struggling to decide what to keep or discard, consider hiring a professional organizer. - **Take Breaks**: Downsizing can be physically and emotionally exhausting, so be sure to take breaks. **Get Professional Junk Removal Help** At 1-800-GOT-JUNK?, our team of experts is here to help with all your junk removal needs.
